new_statements.quote: Unlike other Rgyalrong languages (Sun 2005, Lin 2012), Japhug has no tonal contrasts. However, there is morphologically determined stress. Phonological words only have one stress, which is located by default on the final syllable of the word (regardless of its part of speech). The personal agreement suffixes and the evidential suffix /-ci/ never receive stress, and their vowels are optionally devoiced. For instance, /tɤ-ndza-t-a/ 'I ate it' (PFV-eat-PST-1SG) is realized as [tɤndzátḁ] or [tɤndzáta]. In verbal forms with these prefixes, stress is penultimate, or even antepenultimate in the case of verb forms with two suffixes

new_statements.rule_in_words: One stress per phonological word, by default on the final syllable of the word whatever its word class; placement is morphologically conditioned: person-agreement suffixes and the evidential -ci are never stressed (so suffixed verb forms surface with penultimate or antepenultimate stress), and two prefixes (inverse -wɣ-, negative testimonial mɯ́j-) plus the comitative kɤ́- attract stress. No tone in Japhug.
new_statements.exceptions: Unstressed agreement/evidential suffixes; stress-attracting prefixes /-wɣ-/, /mɯ́j-/; stress-bearing comitative prefix /kɤ́-/ in reduplicated adverbs.
new_statements.domain_note: Phonological word; statement covers Japhug (Kamnyu village) only. Sister languages differ: Situ/Zhuokeji is described as tonal (privative tone, Lin 2012; 'tone is not distinctive', Nagano 2003 p. 470, silent on stress), Tshobdun and Zbu as pitch accent systems (held sources under tsho1240 and zbua1234).
new_statements.identity_note: jiar1242 'Jiarong' is a Glottolog bookkeeping (retired) languoid with no ISO code, coordinates or references; it is not a language. The name/ISO code it stood for (Jiarong [jya] = rGyalrong) now resolves in Glottolog 5.x to the family jiar1240 'Northern Gyalrong' (Japhug japh1234, Tshobdun tsho1240, Zbu zbua1234) plus Situ situ1238 (the 'Jiarong' of Lin Xiangrong 1993, Nagano 2003, WALS). All four already have check folders with first-hand stress/accent statements (Jacques 2019 for Japhug; Lin 2012 and Zhang 2020 for Situ; Sun & Blogros 2019 for Tshobdun; Gong 2018 for Zbu). Catalog under those glottocodes, not under jiar1242 (a retired code does not make a separate language).

sources.note: 'Suprasegmentals', p. 446: no tonal contrasts; morphologically determined stress; one stress per phonological word, by default on the final syllable; agreement suffixes and evidential /-ci/ never stressed (so penult/antepenult in suffixed verb forms); inverse /-wɣ-/ and negative testimonial /mɯ́j-/ attract stress; comitative /kɤ́-/ is stress-bearing.
